blurb: Species recorded near the park, linked by recorded feeding.

tip.title: Remove Sage-of-the-desert

notes: Built automatically, not checked by a person. The species are the most often recorded in GBIF within about 2 km of the park location (location from PAD-US boundary). Feeding links are only those with a GloBI record: for the species itself, its genus or, for plants and insects, its family. Library: automatic.
